# DevOS (dev-os.app)

> DevOS is a developer workspace that manages learning, projects, goals, habits, jobs, notes and coding profiles in one place.

DevOS is designed for software engineers, computer science students, competitive programmers, and technical job seekers who want a centralized operational workflow instead of juggling scattered spreadsheets, generic wikis, and disconnected tools.

## Official Canonical URLs

- Homepage: https://www.dev-os.app/

## The 14 Integrated Workspaces (Modules)

1. Dashboard (https://www.dev-os.app/features/dashboard): High-level operational overview unifying daily habits, active projects, upcoming interview stages, and live competitive coding activity.
2. Coding Profiles Tracker (https://www.dev-os.app/features/coding-profiles): Real-time synchronization of problems solved, contest ratings, ranking percentiles, and badges from LeetCode, Codeforces, and CodeChef.
3. Developer Notes (https://www.dev-os.app/features/notes): Fast, markdown-powered engineering documentation with code syntax highlighting, language filtering, and hierarchical subject/folder organization.
4. Learning Hub (https://www.dev-os.app/features/learning-hub): Structured roadmap builder, tutorial bookmarks, language-specific notes, and DSA curriculum tracking.
5. Projects (https://www.dev-os.app/features/projects): Engineering-focused Kanban boards, tech stack tagging, release milestones, and direct GitHub repository links.
6. Job Application Tracker (https://www.dev-os.app/features/job-tracker): Specialized pipeline tracking tech job applications, interview stages, compensation targets, and technical assessment notes.
7. Technical Resume Builder (https://www.dev-os.app/features/resume-builder): ATS-friendly, markdown-powered developer resume builder customized for software engineering roles.
8. AI Workspace (https://www.dev-os.app/features/ai-workspace): Integrated AI coding assistant for code explanations, debugging assistance, algorithmic refactoring, and technical questions.
9. Calendar (https://www.dev-os.app/features/calendar): Interactive timeline for engineering deadlines, contest schedules, technical interviews, and study sessions.
10. Goals (https://www.dev-os.app/features/goals): Long-term milestone planning and quarterly engineering objectives with progress tracking.
11. Focus Timer (https://www.dev-os.app/features/focus-timer): Customizable Pomodoro timer built for deep coding sessions with flexible interval configurations.
12. Dev Tools Hub (https://www.dev-os.app/features/dev-tools): Quick-launch access to essential developer dashboards, cloud consoles, editors, and external utilities.
13. Developer Network (https://www.dev-os.app/features/network): Shareable digital developer profile card highlighting live competitive handles, portfolio projects, and technical skills.
14. Analytics (https://www.dev-os.app/features/analytics): Visual insights into habit consistency, study volume, problem-solving streaks, and productivity trends.

## Free Client-Side Developer Utilities (No Signup Required)

- JSON Formatter & Validator (https://www.dev-os.app/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, inspect, and minify JSON payloads locally in browser.
- Regex Tester & Debugger (https://www.dev-os.app/tools/regex-tester): Test JavaScript regular expressions in real time with capture group analysis.
- Base64 Encoder / Decoder (https://www.dev-os.app/tools/base64): Encode and decode UTF-8 text and URL-safe Base64 strings client-side.
- UUID v4 Generator (https://www.dev-os.app/tools/uuid-generator): Generate cryptographically secure RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs instantly.

## Objective Comparisons

- DevOS vs Notion for Developers (https://www.dev-os.app/compare/devos-vs-notion): Objective comparison highlighting purpose-built developer tracking vs generic document wikis.
- DevOS vs Trello for Developers (https://www.dev-os.app/compare/devos-vs-trello): Comparison between developer ecosystem workflow boards and standalone Kanban cards.

## Privacy & Security Architecture

DevOS is built with security and privacy by design:
- Client-side utilities run 100% in the user's browser; inputs are never uploaded to any backend.
- Workspace data is isolated and protected via authenticated database sessions with strict PostgreSQL row-level security (RLS).
